sources.name: Reviewed local full-text import
sources.rights_notes: Local import does not establish rights. Every candidate still needs edition-level evidence.

discovery.reason: Local files are added by the editor directly; no network discovery applies.

sources.name: Multilingual Wikisource
sources.rights_notes: Discovery and content fetching use Wikimedia's public Core REST API (api.wikimedia.org/core/v1/wikisource/<lang>/) — the wikisource.org /w/ API is disallowed by robots.txt. Check the work and translation copyright template. Wikisource accepts public-domain or compatible free-licensed texts, but the exact page-level statement remains authoritative.

discovery.searches: Wikimedia Core REST API full-text search across per-language Wikisource wikis (English plus the original-language wiki inferred from the scope)

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.rights_notes: Only ebook files (/files/, /cache/epub/, /ebooks/) — never crawl search or human browsing pages (robots.txt forbids /ebooks/search and the downloader re-checks robots per request). Project Gutenberg copyright determinations are U.S.-specific and the embedded ebook notice must be checked.

discovery.searches: full catalogue feed at /cache/epub/feeds/pg_catalog.csv (robots-permitted path, cached 24 h) matched by title and author against the query

sources.name: Perseus Digital Library GitHub corpora
sources.rights_notes: Rights vary by repository, edition, and translation. Do not inherit a corpus-level licence without checking the selected file and repository metadata. Greek and Latin corpora are under PerseusDL; the Arabic CTS corpus (One Thousand and One Nights, al-Aghani, etc.) is hosted by the Alpheios Project at alpheios-project/cts-texts-arabicLit.

discovery.searches: GitHub Trees API listing of PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit, PerseusDL/canonical-latinLit, and alpheios-project/cts-texts-arabicLit (tree cached 1 h, 60 req/h unauthenticated limit) matched against a TLG/PHI/CTS work-title table and file-path tokens

sources.name: Internet Sacred Text Archive
sources.rights_notes: Most texts are pre-1923 public-domain scans, but the archive also hosts copyrighted and 'not renewed' material. Verify the copyright note on each text's index page before collecting.

discovery.reason: sacred-texts.com is protected by Cloudflare and returns HTTP 403 to all automated requests; manual candidate entry is expected until machine-readable access is confirmed.

sources.name: Internet Archive (texts collection downloads)
sources.rights_notes: Only /download/ item files are permitted. The Archive hosts material under many rights states; check the item's metadata (possible-copyright-status, licenseurl) and the scanned edition's own notice before collecting.

discovery.searches: Internet Archive Advanced Search API (advancedsearch.php) full-text query restricted to mediatype:texts

sources.name: ToposText
sources.rights_notes: ToposText texts are generally CC BY-SA-licensed translations or public-domain editions, but each work page states its own source and licence; record the per-work statement as evidence.

discovery.reason: The works listing is rendered by JavaScript and returns the same 14 KB shell for every query; no JSON endpoint, sitemap or machine-readable catalogue was found.
